verdict.rationale: React's own docs describe server components: frameworks implementing React's architecture let you fetch data in asynchronous components that run on the server (react-docs-7), and the 'use client' directive marks modules as interactive client code (react-docs-10). Streaming server rendering (react-docs-6) and Next.js App Router as a full-stack implementation (react-docs-21) round out the picture, though the capability needs a framework that implements it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of passing server-fetched data as props across the 'use client' boundary, usage without a framework, independent hands-on corroboration.
